elements.label: Floating app window (Model Management page with module cards) scaling down and drifting left over the blue brand background

pattern.description: On the new Model Management page, the whole app window shrinks to about 82% and slides left, so the window edges, drop shadow and blue background curve come back into view; motion is fastest at the start and settles smoothly.
pattern.why_premium: Pulling the window back after the cut gives an overview of all six module cards at once, and the decaying ease-out lands softly instead of snapping to the new framing.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.app-window', {scale: 1.21, x: 70, y: 15}, {scale: 1, x: 0, y: 0, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.out', transformOrigin: '50% 50%'}); background and window shadow stay put; cards move with the window (no stagger).
build_hint.remotion: Window scale = interpolate(frame, [0, 18], [1.21, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) with matching translateX; or spring({frame, fps, config: {damping: 200, stiffness: 120, mass: 1}}) for a no-overshoot settle.

notes: Camera verdict is none: the window wrapper scales inside the frame (scale 0.8245) while the blue background stays still, so this is not a camera move. Energy decays steadily from the first frame, so the start is either a cut or a hard-start ease-out. b02 (card grid) and b03 (right window area) move only as part of the window, so they are not listed separately. Same scale-out continues from e026 and e027 across shots. No SFX candidates.
